notes.title: Whisker Wanderlust: The Wondrous Journey is Now Live! Meow~ (ΦωΦ)
notes.content:
[p]Dear Players,[/p][p]We're overjoyed to announce that after countless days and nights of careful polishing, Whisker Wanderlust: The Wondrous Journey is finally here on Steam!🎉

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3603580/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]
Crafted with Love and Care[/h2][p][b]✦Exquisite Hand-Painted Art✦[/b][/p][p] Every single frame is a lovingly hand-painted piece from our art team, creating the feeling of flipping through a beautiful, painterly storybook. Through the eyes of this little cat, we hope to help you rediscover the beauty and wonder of the world.[/p][p][/p][p][b]✦Rich Content to Explore✦[/b][/p][list][*][p]Over 10 meticulously designed main scenes and levels.[/p][/*][*][p]More than 30 unique NPC friends waiting to meet you.[/p][/*][*][p]Over a thousand charming items scattered everywhere—every discovery is a little surprise![/p][/*][*][p]Each scene features a unique soundtrack, as soothing as the gentle tap of a cat's paw.[/p][/*][*][p]Plus, there are secret levels waiting to be found![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]It's More Than Just a Game[/h2][p]From the very beginning, our intention was simple: to create a world filled with love and warmth. You won't find any intense battles or complex controls here—only the pure curiosity of a little cat and the heartwarming stories it encounters on its journey.[/p][p][/p][p]We believe that in this fast-paced world, everyone needs a place where they can slow down and find some peace. We hope this little cat can join you for some relaxing and wonderful moments.[/p][p][/p][h2]A Special Thank You[/h2][p]A huge thank you to all the players who provided us with invaluable feedback during our beta testing! Every suggestion you shared helped make our little cat even more adorable.[/p][p][/p][h2]Limited-Time Launch Discount & A Special Bundle![/h2][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/56652/_X/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]To celebrate our little cat's big adventure, we're kicking things off with a special launch discount! We've also put together an extra-value bundle for all of our players who own Whisker Wanderlust: The Wondrous Journey! Don't wait, join this heartwarming journey today~[/p][p][/p][p]We are committed to keeping an open dialogue with our players and listening to all your thoughts and suggestions. If you run into any issues in the game, please don't hesitate to reach out to us via the Steam Community Hub or by joining our discord, where our team is ready to help you![/p][p][/p][p]May every cat in the world be loved ♥♥♥[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: It's official! Whisker Wanderlust will officially launch on July 28th!
notes.content: [p][b]It's official! [/b][b][i]Whisker Wanderlust[/i][/b][b] will officially launch on July 28th![/b][/p][p]Thank you for your patience, everyone! [i]Whisker Wanderlust[/i] is finally set to launch on July 18th.[/p][p][b]Embark on an impromptu journey with a little cat, and see a world full of wondrous fantasy through a feline's eyes![/b][/p][p][b]Game Description: Unbelievably Adorable Kitten - See the World Together with Cat ([i]ΦωΦ[/i])[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Each level is an exploration trip brimming with fairy-tale fantasy.[/b] Our signature [b]thick brushstroke hand-painted art style[/b] is one of the game's highlights, making every frame wallpaper-worthy.[/p][/*][*][p]Complementing the visuals, [b]each level features a custom background music track[/b], creating an immersive atmosphere that draws you completely in![/p][/*][/list][p][b]The game includes:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]10 main level scenes + 1 hidden level[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Over 30 interactive NPCs[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]1200 items to find[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][b]✦ GAMEPLAY ✦[/b][/p][olist][*][p][b]Main Quest:[/b] Advance the main storyline by collecting yarn balls within the scenes and unlock the game's final ending.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Commission Quests:[/b] Interact with NPCs in different scenes to unlock commission quests. Help them by collecting more items![/p][/*][*][p][b]Hidden Level:[/b] Collect cans during the main quest to unlock the Postcard Mode. Find cat collars in the postcard treasure chests to unlock the hidden level and complete its task (plus discover a hidden story!).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Art Style & Easter Eggs:[/b] Explore the vibrantly colorful thick brushstroke hand-painted style and uncover classic IP easter eggs.[/p][/*][/olist][p][b]This will be a leisurely and marvelous adventure![/b] You'll see the world from a kitten's perspective and discover a universe filled with magical fantasy. Help the mischievous kitten (who's already chewed through the owner's 376th yarn ball!) collect items from different regions. Meet other companions you encounter along the way and assist them too. In the end, the little cat will find its way back home. [b]May every cat in the world be loved ♥[/b][/p]

notes.title: Come Play with the Kitten on 5.20! Demo Invitation for Whisker Wanderlust
notes.content:
Whisker Wanderlust—Explore the World with a Kitten! The demo playtest officially begins on May 20th. Join us and dive in!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3603580/_/

[b]Demo Details:
First Level Trial: Play through the game’s opening chapter, where you’ll collect and search for yarn balls to progress the main storyline.
NPC Interactions: Take on commission tasks by chatting with characters and helping them find lost items.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45573456/fb76790958dd3f8711f4645f6b1b962d0088b197.jpg[/img]
About Whisker Wanderlust:
Join a mischievous kitten who’s destroyed its owner’s 376th yarn ball! Embark on a cozy adventure to gather replacements while seeing the world through a cat’s eyes—a world brimming with whimsical fantasy. Along the journey, meet quirky companions, lend a paw to solve their problems, and ultimately guide the kitten back home. May every cat in the world be loved ♥♥♥
